notes: Aisha is named only inside Abd al-Malik's speech; Harith's «سمعتها تقول» makes her his source (rule 5), and her «قالت قال رسول الله» makes her the last link (rule 6).
«زاد عليه الوليد بن عطاء» adds wording to a saying Walid already carries as co-transmitter: no second route.
